entities.name: PMID:25428423
observations: Buller E, Cabello J, Ibáñez MJ. “Descriptive study of healthcare professionals' management of tick bites.” Medwave. 2014 Feb 26. DOI: 10.5867/medwave.2014.01.5898.
Cross-sectional descriptive observational study using an anonymous questionnaire among nurses, physicians, and pediatricians at a primary care unit in Medina-Sidonia, Cádiz, Spain.

entities.name: Tick bite management survey
observations: Among surveyed healthcare professionals, 10/11 nurses used products to facilitate tick extraction; 3/12 physicians reported prescribing antibiotics in all cases. Authors concluded practice did not closely follow recommendations for extraction, treatment, and follow-up.
